# CANDIDATE: VIX_GAP_FADE

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When SPY gaps open beyond 0.5% and VIX is elevated (>20), the gap tends to fade intraday as mean reversion kicks in. This edge exists because elevated VIX indicates heightened fear and volatility, making extreme gap openings statistically prone to reversal as the market digests overnight news and rebalances.

## Mechanism

Entry: At 09:35 ET (after the first 5-minute bar), if the open versus prior close gap > +0.5% (gap up) AND the 15-minute VIX > 20, enter short at the close of the 5-minute bar; if gap < -0.5% (gap down) AND VIX > 20, enter long at the close of that bar. Additionally require that the 5-minute bar closes in the opposite direction of the gap (gap-up bar closes below its open, gap-down bar closes above its open) to confirm fade initiation. Exit: Stop at the high/low of the gap bar (for short, stop above gap-bar high; for long, stop below gap-bar low). Target 1.5R, then trail using a chandelier exit (ATR × 2.5) for a runner.

3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not performed)

5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: persistent gap in low-VIX regime (stopped out); max drawdown: consecutive gap failures during volatility expansion; blow-up scenario: gap continuation during macro event (e.g., FOMC) with VIX > 30
